text: The CHC30121- Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care is a course that will help you gain the confidence you need to become an engaging childcare provider. If you are enthusiastic about the growth of young children and would like to learn more about delivering quality education and care in a variety of situations, then this course is for you. The CHC30113-Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care has been replaced by the CHC30121-Certificate III in Early Childhood and Care. The qualification's core and optional courses have significantly changed to match sector standards.

Domestic students can pursue this course at Job Training Institute even for government funding if they meet the eligibility criteria. This government funding is provided through Skill’s First Program. It is accessible to Victoria residents who qualify or are eligible to pursue this course. To know about the eligibility requirements, [click here](https://jti.edu.au/apply/index.php?p=gov).
This CHC30121-[Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care](/course/certificate-iii-in-early-childhood-education-and-care) course will:

items: Prepare you for engaging in a job in the childcare industry.
Let you Study for a total of 18 Units of study: Made up of 15 core and 3 elective units.
This Curriculum gives students the opportunity to work with a variety of age groups of kids, incresing employment prospects, training opportunities, and career routes.

text: What You Will Learn From CHC30121-Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care at Job Training Institute?

items: The regulations and procedures governing the children's services sectors.
Organizing activites and looking after kids.
Directing play and leisure to help kids reach their development goals
Play a crucial part in helping kids develop their social skills and in promting learning and play.

text: How Can You Pursue This Course?
The programme will be delivered using a mixed mode.

items: Classroom-based learning, where a teacher or trainer is present when the student attends a JTI Campus.
Online learning is also provided by JTI, where a student learns remotely, off campus, utilising correspondence from teacher or trainer or online training resources.

text: What Are The Possible Job Positions to Work in the Childcare Industry?
After finishing your CHC30121-Certificate III in Early Childhood Education and Care course, you can work in the following job positions:

items: Childcare Educator
Childcare Worker
Family Day care worker
Nanny

text: Career Pathways

text: What Sets JTI Apart From Other Training Institutions?
1. Effective Instruction and Delivery

JTI has continually supported high-quality training and delivery, earning the best grade a provider can get from our regulator, the Australian Skills Quality Authority: "Demonstrated Consistently Compliant" (ASQA).

In all standards provided by the Victorian Government, JTI was evaluated as being above the national median by the Department of Education in Victoria as of 2018. Reviews for student experience and student results were among the standards that were examined. In 2018, 87% of JTI students said they were happy with the training they received from us, which was 10% better than the 77% standard for all RTOs in the Victorian State.
2. Variety and Diversity

At JTI, we take part in a number of social and community activities throughout the year, such as Multicultural Day and Australia Day, to celebrate our multicultural heritage and to appreciate all cultures. We acknowledge that transitioning to a new nation may occasionally be challenging, therefore our capacity to connect with students and staff from various backgrounds and walks of life facilitates students' adjustment to life at JTI. Together, we can do anything, we think!
3. Flexibility

We give students flexibility through mixed learning, including face-to-face, online, and self-study options. This flexibility helps many of our senior students to maintain the balance between employment, school, and family responsibilities.
4. Industry Collaborations

Our teaching is industry-relevant and focused, and we keep good industry ties that help our students land internships, clinical rotations, and positions when their course is through. We have employer days so students may meet potential employers, and we also host an annual industry luncheon where we can stay current on standards and trends.
5. Community Oriented

JTI participates in a variety of community activities in the areas where we have offices. Two of our campuses have poor social and economic demography, thus it is our duty to make sure the students who are enrolled there receive excellent student support so they can finish their coursework and enter the workforce. Numerous support sessions are held by both our trainers and student support officers to motivate students to keep going when things are difficult.
Conclusion

Thus, the Early Childhood Education sector has good career prospects with ample job opportunities. With this course, you will learn how to interact with kids successfully and how to professionally look for infants, toddlers, and kids, including how to feed them and give them basic medical treatment to support their well-being.
